title: Flags & places: which flag is Canada?
explanation: Canada’s flag has a red maple leaf between two red bands. The other flags belong to United States, Spain, Australia.

options.alt: A flag: The United States flag has red and white stripes and white stars on blue.
A flag: Australia’s flag is dark blue with a small Union Jack and white stars.
